goal: Map nodes: outline = bubble color, fill = personal color
summary: Map nodes are two-tone: the fill is the person's own color and a ring inside the disc's edge is the bubble they're shown in. Only nodeCanvasObject in components/map/SocialGraph.tsx changed (plus a NODE_RING constant and the interestHue import). Ring color = n.color (the existing per-frame bubble tone: group hue while inside the bubble outline, stone/gray outside, crossfades unchanged). Fill = the user's identity color (palette hex of interestHue(first interest), stone with no interests) because no user-chosen color is stored anywhere yet. Ring width = clamp(r*0.25, >= 2.5px on screen, <= 40% of r), drawn inside the radius so node size is unchanged; avatar photos now clip inside the ring (was r*0.92) so they don't cover it. Paper rim, shadow, me-rings, search/ringed halos, labels and sizes are untouched.

decisions.what: Fill uses identityColor's hue (first interest) as the personal color
decisions.why: There is no user-defined color in the schema, API or profile form; the brief says to use the existing default user color in that case and not add backend changes.

decisions.what: Ring has a minimum on-screen width
decisions.why: At r*0.22 alone it was ~1px on small (friendship-distance-scaled) circles and the bubble color wasn't noticeable.

verification.manual: In-memory demo of this commit: ML Paper Club members show a rose ring with ochre centers; Maya (green center) inside ML had the same rose ring; after joining Late Night Chess her ring turned ochre and her center stayed green; no-interest users: none exist (sign-up requires 3) but code falls back to stone. Clicking a node still opens the profile card; no window errors.

open_questions: To let people actually pick their color: add users.color (VARCHAR2(9) or a hue key) to schema.sql + migrate --upgrade, both stores, the profile patch schema and a picker in ProfileForm; then read it in place of the first-interest hue in nodeCanvasObject (one line).
